description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across five distinct methods: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and an unlabeled gray bar, likely representing a baseline or control condition. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance,” ranges from 0 to 60 in increments of 10, with horizontal gridlines aiding visual alignment. The horizontal axis lists the method names as categorical labels. Each method is represented by a single vertical bar of a unique color: Standard (orange) at approximately 53, Self-RAG (beige) at about 54, FactTune (light green) at roughly 52, CInGS (w/) (blue) at around 54, and the final gray bar at approximately 59, which is the highest value. The bars are not sorted by height, and no error bars or statistical annotations are present. The chart visually suggests that the gray-labeled method outperforms the others, while Self-RAG and CInGS (w/) show comparable performance slightly above Standard and FactTune. The title “Paper: Context-Informed Grounding Supervision” implies the chart is from a research paper evaluating these methods in the context of grounding supervision tasks.
